text: [photo: revised night rota]
Revised. Swapped Faith and Daniel on the 3rd and 4th. Otieno you're off the 6th now

Ok good
Can I swap the 9th? My mother's thing in Nakuru
Daniel I'll look. Might need to move Faith
Sorry phone was in the locker. Morning was bad, generator cut out in the middle of a section
Is theatre ok now
Yeah the UPS held. Baby's fine
Good
Supplier emailed. Gloves delayed till the 10th
And they're out of 2-0 vicryl
Then order the sutures now. Don't wait for the gloves
I'll put the order in tonight after handover
Can someone confirm the 9th. I'm not sure if I'm on or off
You're on. Daniel's off, you're covering his night
Ok
Order's in. Sent to the supplier with the sutures marked urgent
Also someone please tell the ward the generator service is on the 2nd, not the 3rd
Still up. The rota file won't open for me on the phone, can someone resend it as pdf
